lore_anchors.definition: The floating jade palace at the heart of the Chaotic Star Sea’s secret trial; a major dungeon arc where sects compete for ancient treasures
A rare spirit spider vital to unlocking the innermost chamber of the Void Heaven Palace
One of the two deadly paths in the Void Heaven Palace’s middle trial; its sudden upheaval was caused by Star Palace tampering
The fourth major cultivation realm in a cultivator’s progression, marking the birth of a soul body that can survive the destruction of the physical form
A magic weapon from an ancient era, distinct from modern counterparts; often more powerful but cannot be absorbed into the body
The next trial after the treasure pavilions; a mental/spiritual challenge that separates the worthy from the unworthy
A leading Nascent Soul cultivator of the demonic path and the master of the Ghost Spirit Sect delegation
A forbidden, dark-aligned alternative to the orthodox Golden Core, associated with blood-path cultivation
The third major cultivation realm, where a cultivator solidifies their power into an internal core

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is everyone so anxious about Han Li?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His Blood Jade Spider is the only reliable key to bypass the innermost seal of the Void Heaven Palace; without it, the Nascent Soul cultivators cannot reach the supreme treasure.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did nobody confront the Star Palace elders?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Star Palace's reputation as the dominant force in the Chaotic Star Sea is so overwhelming that even Nascent Soul cultivators hesitate to provoke them directly; the cost of a confrontation is higher than swallowing the loss.

It is a direct path to the next trial with no treasure pavilion along the way; the restriction is designed to exploit greed—most cultivators cannot bear the thought of leaving a potential prize unclaimed.
